map.note: A function is re-read lazily (before drawing and about once a second while the form is open and no map is known), so a cabinet opened before the map is ready enables drawing as soon as the getter returns the map.

handle_semantics.openObject: (id: string) -> Promise<boolean>. Called before the editor's own GET /session has answered, the promise waits for that one request. false when not signed in (the record is then opened right after a successful login), not found/refused (no fields shown) or superseded by a later navigation; true when the form is open
handle_semantics.setMap: (map|null) -> void; detaches layers/listeners from the old map and attaches to the new one. With a map getter in options, setMap(null) only detaches: the getter supplies the map again on the next lookup
handle_semantics.destroy: idempotent; removes map layers/sources/listeners, DOM listeners and timers; unsaved form goes to the per-tab copy

civic-editor:tool.expectation: while active: Escape cancels the tool (not the cabinet); R03 should ignore its own map clicks/hover cursor

keyboard.Escape: The editor calls preventDefault() when it handled Escape itself (active tool, confirmation, logout prompt) and when Escape is pressed inside an input/textarea/select or while the re-login, conflict or duplicate panel is open. The shell closes the cabinet only if !event.defaultPrevented.

local_copy.holds: form fields only, bound to the signed-in user name
